RLX Technology Announces Unaudited Third Quarter
2026 Financial Results
SHENZHEN,
November 20, 2026 /PRNEWSWIRE/ - RLX Technology Inc. (“RLX Technology” or the “Company”) (NYSE: RLX), a leading
global branded e-vapor company, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30,
2026.
Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights
| · | Net revenues were RMB1,916.6 million (US$285.9
million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 69.7% from RMB1,129.3 million in the same period of 2025. |
| · | Gross profit increased by 26.7% to RMB446.6 million (US$66.6 million)
in the third quarter of 2026. |
| · | Gross margin was 23.3% in the third quarter
of 2026, compared with 31.2% in the same period of 2025, primarily due to a change in the revenue mix following the consolidation of the
Company’s newly acquired European entity. |
| · | Non-GAAP
income from operations 1 was
RMB143.8 million (US$21.4 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB187.8 million
in the same period of 2025. |
| · | U.S. GAAP net income was RMB147.1 million
(US$21.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB206.8 million in the same period of 2025. |
| · | Non-GAAP net income 1 was RMB235.6
million (US$35.1 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB295.4 million in the same period of 2025. |
“The
third quarter marked a defining inflection point for RLX as we integrated our newly acquired European distribution platform with our existing
retail footprint, evolving into a leading global smoke-free brand,” said Ms. Ying (Kate) Wang, Co-founder, Chairperson, and
Chief Executive Officer of RLX Technology. “We now possess end-to-end capabilities spanning global product innovation, supply chain
execution, and direct route-to-market reach, while always placing our brands at the heart of adult consumers’ choices worldwide.
By pairing these strengths with dedicated local field teams and an open, multi-brand ecosystem philosophy, we are gaining sharper retail
insights that will empower us to tailor products to local consumer preferences, scale our multi-category portfolio, and capture market
share as shifting global regulations reshape the industry.”
Mr. Chao
Lu, Chief Financial Officer of RLX Technology, commented, “We delivered strong third quarter financial results, with the consolidation
driving a surge in net revenues to RMB1.92 billion, up 69.7% year over year. International markets contributed 86.5% of our top line.
While our blended gross margin now reflects the consolidation of the distribution business,
we maintained solid non-GAAP profitability, improved working capital efficiency, and achieved a healthy sequential rebound in operating
cash flow. Looking ahead, we are actively lifting our European platform’s margins through supply chain optimization and capital
deployment, while navigating transitional working capital needs related to the UK’s October introduction of an excise duty.
Supported by RMB13.48 billion in total financial assets, we have the financial flexibility to fund global brand expansion, deliver long-term
sustainable growth, and maintain strong shareholder returns.”
Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
Net revenues were RMB1,916.6 million (US$285.9
million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 69.7% from RMB1,129.3 million in the same period of 2025. The increase was primarily
due to the consolidation of the Company’s newly acquired European entity in July 2026. Net revenues from international business
represented 86.5% of net revenues for the period.
1  Non-GAAP net income and non-GAAP income from operations
are non-GAAP financial measures. For more information on the Company’s non-GAAP financial measures, please see the section “Non-GAAP
Financial Measures” and the table captioned “Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Results” set forth at the end of this
press release.
Gross profit was RMB446.6 million (US$66.6
million) in the third quarter of 2026, increasing by 26.7% from RMB352.6 million in the same period of 2025.
Gross margin was 23.3% in the third quarter
of 2026, compared with 31.2% in the same period of 2025, primarily due to a change in the revenue mix following the consolidation of the
Company’s newly acquired European entity.
Operating expenses were RMB407.1 million
(US$60.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB259.3 million in the same period of 2025. The increase was primarily
due to higher salary and welfare expenses and increased shipping and logistics costs.
Selling expenses were RMB182.9 million
(US$27.3 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB132.3 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due to increases
in salary and welfare expenses and shipping and logistics costs.
General and administrative expenses were
RMB185.9 million (US$27.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB85.7 million in the same period of 2025, primarily due
to higher salary and welfare expenses and legal and other consulting fees.
Research and development expenses were
RMB38.3 million (US$5.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB41.3 million in the same period of 2025.
U.S. GAAP income from operations was RMB39.5
million (US$5.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB93.3 million in the same period of 2025.
Non-GAAP income from operations was RMB143.8
million (US$21.4 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB187.8 million in the same period of 2025.
Income tax expense was RMB43.6 million
(US$6.5 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB45.9 million in the same period of 2025.
U.S. GAAP net income was RMB147.1 million
(US$21.9 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB206.8 million in the same period of 2025.
Non-GAAP net income was RMB235.6 million
(US$35.1 million) in the third quarter of 2026, compared with RMB295.4 million in the same period of 2025.
U.S. GAAP basic and diluted net income per
American depositary share (“ADS”) were RMB0.131 (US$0.020) and RMB0.123 (US$0.018), respectively, in the third quarter of
2026, compared with U.S. GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB0.167 and RMB0.157, respectively, in the same period of 2025.
Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per
ADS 2 were RMB0.186 (US$0.028) and RMB0.175 (US$0.026), respectively, in the third quarter of 2026, compared with non-GAAP
basic and diluted net income per ADS of RMB0.236 and RMB0.221, respectively, in the same period of 2025.
2  Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS is
a non-GAAP financial measure. For more information on the Company’s non-GAAP financial measures, please see the section “Non-GAAP
Financial Measures” and the table captioned “Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Results” set forth at the end of this
press release.
Balance Sheet and Cash Flow
As of September 30, 2026, the Company had
cash and cash equivalents, restricted cash, short-term bank deposits, net, short-term investments, long-term bank deposits, net, and long-term
investment securities, net, of RMB13,482.8 million (US$2,011.0 million), compared with RMB13,883.4 million as of June 30, 2026. In
the third quarter of 2026, net cash generated from operating activities was RMB40.0 million (US$6.0 million).

About RLX Technology Inc.
RLX Technology Inc. (NYSE: RLX) is a leading global
branded e-vapor company. The Company leverages its strong in-house technology, product development capabilities and in-depth insights
into adult smokers’ needs to develop superior e-vapor products.
For more information, please visit: http://ir.relxtech.com .
Non-GAAP Financial Measures
The Company uses non-GAAP net income, non-GAAP
income from operations and non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS, each a non-GAAP financial measure, in evaluating its operating
results and for financial and operational decision-making purposes. Non-GAAP net income represents net income excluding share-based compensation
expenses, amortization and depreciation of assets arising from fair value step-up in business acquisitions, and tax effects on non-GAAP
adjustments. Non-GAAP income from operations represents net income from operations excluding share-based compensation expenses and amortization
and depreciation of assets arising from fair value step-up in business acquisitions. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS is
computed using non-GAAP net income attributable to RLX Technology Inc. and the same number of ADSs used in the U.S. GAAP basic and diluted
net income per ADS calculation.
The Company presents these non-GAAP financial
measures because they are used by the management to evaluate its operating performance and formulate business plans. The Company believes
that they help identify underlying trends in its business that could otherwise be distorted by the effect of certain expenses that are
included in net income. The Company also believes that the use of the non-GAAP measures facilitates investors’ assessment of its operating
performance, as they could provide useful information about its operating results, enhance the overall understanding of its past performance
and future prospects, and allow for greater visibility with respect to key metrics used by the management in its financial and operational
decision making.
The non-GAAP financial measures are not defined
under U.S. GAAP and are not presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. The non-GAAP financial measures have limitations as analytical tools.
They should not be considered in isolation or construed as an alternative to net income, basic and diluted net income per ADS or any other
measure of performance or as an indicator of its operating performance. Investors are encouraged to review its historical non-GAAP financial
measures against the most directly comparable U.S. GAAP measures. The non-GAAP financial measures here may not be comparable to similarly
titled measures presented by other companies. Other companies may calculate similarly titled measures differently, limiting their usefulness
as comparative measures to our data. The Company encourages investors and others to review its financial information in its entirety and
not rely on any single financial measure.
For more information on the non-GAAP financial
measures, please see the table captioned “Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP Results” set forth at the end of this
press release.

from RMB to U.S. dollars and from U.S. dollars to RMB are made at a rate of RMB6.7045 to US$1.00, the exchange rate on September 30,
